answer: SELECT u.DisplayName FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'
SELECT p.Id, u.DisplayName FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId WHERE p.CreaionDate LIKE '2010%' ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT c.Text, u.DisplayName FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON p.Id = c.PostId LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = c.UserId WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(Reputation)) AS INTEGER) FROM users WHERE Id IN (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE Tags LIKE '%<r>%' AND Score < 20)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(Reputation), 2) FROM users WHERE Id IN (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate LIKE '2010%') AND LOWER(TRIM(Location)) = 'india'
SELECT ROUND(AVG(UpVotes), 2), ROUND(AVG(Age), 2) FROM users WHERE Id IN (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate LIKE '2012%' GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(*) > 10)
